component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.assets.watermark.operations
component.documentation: Since 0.5.0, Asset.GetWatermarked: a use of an asset its rights policy's watermark marks, served marked for the person signed in, where the platform's download endpoints refuse it unmarked (watermark-required). It decides the use's rights as a download of it is decided, and serves nothing the watermark does not mark. A picture is drawn on the server in Java; a video goes through the platform's video tools, which need ffmpeg, and is refused, watermark-unavailable, where they are not available. It changes nothing.
